study_identification_part.si_4_title: Shared differential factors underlying individual spontaneous neural activity abnormalities in major depressive disorder

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Two large multi-center datasets were used: (1) DIDA-MDD (Disease Imaging Data Archiving-Major Depressive Disorder Working Group) comprising 9 research sites as the discovery dataset, and (2) REST-meta-MDD consortium comprising 25 research sites as the validation dataset.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: This study included two extensive multi-center datasets comprising 2424 patients with MDD and 2183 HCs sourced from the Disease Imaging Data Archiving-Major Depressive Disorder Working Group (DIDA-MDD) and REST-meta-MDD consortium. The DIDA-MDD encompassed nine research sites... The validation dataset was sourced from the REST-meta-MDD consortium (http://rfmri.org/REST-meta-MDD), comprising 25 research sites

answer.DIDA-MDD: discovery dataset for normative modeling training and main analyses

answer.REST-meta-MDD: validation dataset for replication and generalizability assessment

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: DIDA-MDD served as the discovery dataset where normative models were trained using HCs and individualized ALFF abnormalities were calculated for MDD patients. REST-meta-MDD served as the validation dataset to replicate all main findings and assess generalizability. Cross-dataset validation was also performed (training on one dataset and testing on the other).
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: All analyses were initially conducted in the discovery dataset and subsequently replicated in the validation dataset unless specified otherwise... a Gaussian process regression was trained based on HCs in the discovery dataset and then used to infer ALFF values for HCs in the validation dataset, and vice versa
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Han2024B.pdf.md: Methods / Samples, L87; Methods / Modeling individualized ALFF abnormalities, L96-L97

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Two separate normative models were constructed: one using HCs from DIDA-MDD (discovery, N=1079) and one using HCs from REST-meta-MDD (validation, N=1104). The models used Gaussian process regression trained on HCs to estimate normative ALFF ranges based on age and sex. 10-fold cross-validation and leave-one-site-out cross-validation were used for performance evaluation, but specific train/test split numbers are not reported.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: The DIDA-MDD encompassed nine research sites... the final sample included 1148 patients with MDD... and 1079 HCs... The validation dataset was sourced from the REST-meta-MDD consortium... comprising 25 research sites with 1276 patients diagnosed with MDD... and 1104 HCs
